text: The working file carries no processing identifier (CRID), cycle or pass number, xovr_cal_q or bitwise quality flag for any of its 52 passes. So it cannot be read from the data that calendar 2024 is all PGD0 (the signed swot-lakes page says it should be), a later window cannot be guarded against mixed processing from a file of this shape, the three overpass tracks had to be inferred from repeat-cycle phase (LOOK-011), and the reason for reach_q 2 on three passes cannot be seen. It also keeps only two hourly gauge readings around the passes of February and March (LOOK-009, LOOK-012), which is why two passes are unpaired at 15 minutes.
from: an exploration: what it says was seen while exploring and is not a tested claim
